newsitem.title: USA: Young TV station buy cleared by FCC.
newsitem.headline: Young TV station buy cleared by FCC.

text.p: Young Broadcasting Inc said on Tuesday that the Federal Communications Commission has approved the transfer of the television license of KCAL-TV, Channel 9, in Los Angeles, to the company.
The approval clears the way for Young Broadcasting to complete its previously announced acquisition of the station from the Walt Disney Co.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in early November, the company said.
Young Broadcasting currently owns 11 television stations affiliated with ABC, CBS and NBC in Illinois, Iowa, Louisiana, Michigan, New York, South Dakota, Tennessee, Virginia, and Wisconsin.
